company_summary.one_line_business: IEPL is an investment holding company and its 50% subsidiary AEC is in the business of marketing, promoting and distributing new energy products including new energy storage solutions, new energy charging stations and new energy vehicles under the brand “Admiral Energy” in the territories of Australia, New Zealand, China (including Hong Kong, Taiwan and Macau), South Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Laos, Myanmar, and the Philippines.
